newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AIG Inc in S.African insurance joint venture.
newsitem.headline: AIG Inc in S.African insurance joint venture.

text.p: A black South African civic body on Wednesday signed a letter of intent with financial services group America International Group Inc (AIG) to form a joint venture to sell consumer insurance products.

The South African National Civics Organisation (SANCO)'s investment arm, with a membership of 1.2 million, will market the products to its members through a network of 200 representatives, the two parties said in a joint statement.
AIG will offer products including accident and health insurance. The underwriter would be AIG's South African operation.
AIG is a U.S.-based international insurance organisation offering a wide range of financial services.
